name: Is the caller a signed-in admin
description: Whether this session is an admin, for nginx's auth_request in front of the Orion console: 204 for an admin, 401 for a missing or revoked session, 403 for anyone else, and no body -- the three answers and their emptiness are the contract with `auth_request`. It opens with the same `admin-only` fragment every admin route does, so the role is read off the live session row and a demotion takes effect on the console's next request.

tasks.name: Allow
tasks.description: 204, and deliberately no body. `auth_request` discards a subrequest body anyway, and a probe that answered with the user's identity would be an unauthenticated way to read it back from anywhere the cookie reaches.
